newsitem.title: BELGIUM: New Dexia Belgium shares start trade on June 26.
newsitem.headline: New Dexia Belgium shares start trade on June 26.

text.p: Dexia Belgium, the Belgian arm of French-Belgian banking group Dexia, said in a statement on Wednesday that trade in a second tranche of its shares was due to start on June 26.

Dexia said that Holding Communal, a holding company 100 percent owned by Belgium's municipalities, would offer 13.5 percent of its Dexia Belgium shares, with a green shoe of an additional two percent.
The new shares will be sold ex-dividend and therefore have no right to the 117 Belgian francs per share gross dividend on 1996 earnings which will be paid on June 25.
Following the sale, the stake of Holding Communal in Dexia Belgium will fall to 52 percent, or to 50 percent plus one share if the green shoe is fully exercised.
Bookbuilding for institutionals runs from June 11 to 24. A maximum price for the issue will be published on June 14 and the offer for Belgian retail investors will run from June 16 to 23.
On June 26, Dexia will announce the final price, detail share allocation and shares will start trading. Payment date is July 1.
The total offer will be worth about 20 billion Belgian francs if the green shoe is exercised. --Brussels +32 2 287 6813
